caption: The drawing depicts a small, square log cabin positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The cabin is constructed from bluish-gray logs that are shown in horizontal layers, with rounded ends visible at the cabin’s corners. The roof is pyramidal in shape, covered in neat rows of rectangular, muted green shingles, culminating in a central square chimney structure made of the same coloration. The visible sides of the cabin each have a single window framed in matching wood, and the front side has a centered wooden door with a rectangular panel. The entire composition is clean and simple, with the cabin occupying the lower center portion, leaving ample blank space above and around it.
title: Box (Log Cabin)
